reponse:
Both were picked up, but only the webhook issue is closed:

- **Webhook signature failures:** Jake took ownership on the call and Ellen sent failing event IDs afterward [1][5]. He traced the mismatch to the delivery worker re-serializing the signed JSON, merged a fix, and deployed it to sandbox on November 16 [6][11]. Ellen confirmed on November 17 that 300+ events now verify successfully [5].
- **Per-seller payout schedules:** Tradewell needs net-7 for roughly 200 top sellers and net-30 for the rest [1]. Owen took it to product and engineering; Sofia opened QPAY-2362, Tomer estimated 3–4 weeks, and Avi ruled out delivery for December 7, targeting late January/Q1 2027 instead [3]. Owen promised Martin an answer by November 20, but Martin was still chasing it on November 17, and I found no later reply in the thread [5].

So the remaining customer-facing risk is the payout-schedule expectation, not the webhooks.
